messages:
sam_sales: BeaconMed wants a 2-week POC to validate a finetuned Llama-70B variant (they call it bm-70b-ft). Primary asks: can we onboard the model into our catalog, what's KV/cache behavior for ~2k token sessions, and a ballpark for 150k tokens/day. They also sent a compliance packet and want CMK/KMS options. Packet: https://beaconmed.example/compliance.pdf

  tess_se: Thanks. @imran_eng can you run a quick catalog-fit pass? checklist: tokenizer parity, adapter compatibility (HF adapters), quant format (q8_0 vs q4_*), and whether we need to bundle the tokenizer. Also confirm if Hosted can satisfy their KMS request or Private is required.

  imran_eng: Dug into their HF repo. Observations: base model is Llama-3-70B, adapters are LoRA-style with additional tokenizer.json that adds 5 special tokens. Our catalog expects standard tokens; we'll need to ingest their tokenizer or map tokens at load. Quick cli to validate:
  ```
  from transformers import AutoTokenizer
  tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('beacon/bm-70b-ft')
  print(len(tok))
  print(tok.special_tokens_map)
  ```
  If that shows extra special tokens we must package the tokenizer with the model bundle. Also, quant: they supplied a q8_0 dump -> fine for hosted. q4 variants not supported in hosted prod yet. We can stage q4 on a Dedicated pool but requires kernel deployment.

  tess_se: Good. Flag the tokenizer bundle ask to the customer as a must-have for the POC. If they push a thin wrapper we can still run a quick functional test with a temp mapping but prefer canonical bundle.

  zara_sec: BeaconMed requires HIPAA, encrypted-at-rest for model artifacts, CMK-based key rotation and per-request audit logs with 1yr retention. They prefer Private deployment but will consider Dedicated if we provide strict VPC isolation and attestations. I attached our HIPAA checklist and the template for KMS integration. Need @imran_eng to confirm artifact encryption options and @nina_acct to note pricing implications.

  nina_acct: Pricing ballpark for 150k tokens/day (~4.5M/mo): Hosted (gen-heavy) estimate: generation ~ $0.010/token, context ~ $0.0009/token => rough $45k/mo. Dedicated reserve approach: 2x A100-equivalent pool with quant kernels + base infra/support ~ $22k/mo commit + variable infra costs. Exact depends on average tokens per request and concurrency. @sam_sales do they expect steady traffic or spiky bursts?

  ben_ops: KV cache: 2k seq -> per-session KV ~180-210MB depending on kv dtype and quant layout. If sessions are sticky and we can keep KV warm, compute costs drop ~25-50% for long dialogs. Recommend enabling prefix caching and set min_workers to avoid cold-starts during POC. Also note: our Hosted runtime has q8_0 latency profile stable; q4 will need a kernel push (planning window 2 business days).

  imran_eng: Kernel plan: we can accept q8_0 artifacts and run immediately on Hosted for limited trials. For q4f16/q4f32, we'll need to stage a kernel update to a Dedicated pool; ops timeline ~48-72h to validate. If BeaconMed can do q8_0 for the POC, we can run perf + accuracy checks this week.

  tess_se: Next steps (short):
  1) @sam_sales ask BeaconMed to upload the tokenizer bundle and 10 representative prompts + expected outputs
  2) BeaconMed to confirm deployment preference (Private vs Dedicated) and willingness to accept q8_0 for POC
  3) @nina_acct to draft a 30-day estimate for Hosted vs Dedicated once concurrency is provided
  4) @imran_eng spin a quick functional test on a dev Dedicated slot if they prefer Dedicated, or schedule Hosted trial runs for q8_0
  5) @zara_sec send HIPAA intake + KMS template and request any missing compliance artifacts

  sam_sales: I'll request the tokenizer bundle and prompts today. They want a kickoff call Thu. I'll ask about concurrency and whether they can accept q8_0.

  deploy-bot: Ticket SALES-19876 created: "BeaconMed POC - bm-70b-ft onboarding, KMS, HIPAA, pricing" assignees: tess_se, imran_eng, zara_sec, nina_acct. Status: open.
